data_fields.name: HP gate for group members
data_fields.donor_constant: member counts only if hitpoints is truthy (non-zero)

data_fields.name: group bar hidden when summed HP is at most
single versus group switch
data_fields.donor_constant: exactly 1 member is single, 2 or more is group

best_idea: Summarise a group as one bar, the sum of current HP over the sum of max HP, clamped, with a count, and hide it when no member has HP.
decision_why: The one-bar group summary is what the many-on-one attack set (up to MAX_ATTACKERS = 3) needs, but the donor sums the player's own selection, not enemies on the hero; max-HP weighting is a design choice to make on purpose; capture bars and carried or loot totals do not apply to a duel and are rejected.
acceptance: With three enemies attacking the hero, a group bar and a count of 3 sit above their frame; when one dies the bar drops by that enemy's share of the total HP, and a test over the engine's attack set asserts the frame value equals sum(hp) / sum(maxHp) for the same three entities.
